description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for accessing PredefinedShelf entities in the database, including custom query methods and fetch graph annotations.

classes.name: PredefinedShelfRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for PredefinedShelf entities, providing CRUD operations and custom queries for pre-defined shelves.

methods.name: findAllByUser
methods.description: Retrieves all predefined shelves for a specific user, including associated books.

methods.name: findByPredefinedShelfNameAndUser
methods.description: Finds a predefined shelf by its name and user.

methods.name: countAllByUser
methods.description: Counts the number of shelves associated with a specific user.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a predefined shelf by its ID.

methods.name: findReadShelf2
methods.description: Custom query method to find shelves labeled as 'READ' (using a specific enum value).
